title: Tool output issue: update_task — parameter named 'id' not 'task_id'; error message does not suggest correct name
description: update_task requires parameter 'id' but the natural expectation from context is 'task_id'. In run c6af8022-8df4-4edf-8bb0-97b1a8dda8b8, 9 update_task calls were made with 'task_id' as the parameter name. All 9 failed with 'Warning: no task with id \'' in the current task list.' — an error that does not reveal the correct parameter name. A ToolSearch call was required to discover the schema, costing an extra round-trip.
proposed_resolution: Either rename the 'id' parameter to 'task_id' in the update_task tool definition, or update the error message to include 'did you mean to use parameter "id"?' when the supplied arguments contain a 'task_id' key that does not match any registered parameter.
